author: Sue
content:
An Outstanding Company – We Wouldn’t Use Anyone Else!

We have been using Monster Event Company for the past eight years to deliver our annual student reward event, The Big Bash, and I honestly cannot recommend them highly enough!

The Big Bash is the highlight of our year. It is a huge reward for our students, and they work incredibly hard throughout the year because they want to earn their place at this fantastic event. With approximately 180 children attending, it is a big occasion, and Monster Event Company helps us make it truly unforgettable. The range of inflatables and games they provide gives the students so much choice, fun and excitement, and the children absolutely love it!

What really sets Monster Event Company apart is their outstanding customer service and professionalism from start to finish. From the moment you make an enquiry, they respond promptly, communicate brilliantly and make sure every detail is checked and double-checked. They provide photographs of the equipment, offer helpful suggestions and work with you to find options that suit your budget. You feel supported and confident that everything is in safe hands.

On the day itself, the team are absolutely fantastic. They arrive early, set everything up professionally, are on hand to help manage the event and return to dismantle everything at the end. They are organised, friendly, efficient and completely self-sufficient, requiring virtually no supervision from us. This makes such a difference when you are organising an event for so many students.

Quite simply, this is the easiest reward event we organise all year, thanks to the team at Monster Event Company. They take away the stress, deliver exactly what they promise and help create an experience that our students look forward to all year long.

After eight years of working with them, I can honestly say I cannot fault them. Their reliability, attention to detail and commitment to making the event a success are second to none.

If you are looking for a company to deliver an exciting, professionally managed event that your students or guests will absolutely love, look no further than Monster Event Company. They are a huge part of what makes our Big Bash so special, and we look forward to working with them for many years to come!
